name: HH270 MMS2

images.note: Orion B block; coords from ALMA archive (2015.1.00041.S); no SIMBAD entry

paper.title: The VLA/ALMA Nascent Disk and Multiplicity (VANDAM) Survey of Orion Protostars. III. Substructures in Protostellar Disks

notes: Class 0 protostellar disk in Orion B (HH 270/271 outflow region), imaged in the VANDAM Orion survey (Sheehan et al. 2020; ALMA 2015.1.00041.S). A legitimate standalone mm source; no YSO SIMBAD entry (only a coincident 2MASS NIR source, J05512257+0255433, at the position).
